journal: Can. J. Chem. 52, 3738-3741 (title as printed: Apparent Molal Volumes and Heat Capacities of Alkaline Earth Chlorides in Water at 25 C; authors G. Perron, J. E. Desnoyers, F. J. Millero)
experimental_method: Densities with a flow densimeter and relative volumetric specific heats with a flow microcalorimeter, 0.01 to 0.4 M, 25 C; solutions prepared by weight dilution of AgNO3-titrated stock solutions.
uncertainties_stated: Relative change in specific heat to +-0.3 % (down to sensitivity limit 1.7e-? J/K/cm3, as printed, text layer garbled); density differences to +-3e-6 g/cm3.
quality_remarks: Reagent grade Fisher salts without further purification; agreement with Dunn and Wirth-Bangert densities to about 0.1 cm3/mol except dilute MgCl2 (present phi_V lower). Temperature scale not stated. Only MgCl2 and CaCl2 are in the six-ion salt set; SrCl2 and BaCl2 rows kept.

row_counts.table_1: printed 35 data rows + 4 salt label rows; written 35 + 4

extraction_notes: Text layer dropped the phi_V, sigma-ratio, phi_C and c_p columns, so the whole table was transcribed from the 200 dpi page image (m, c, d-d0 also cross-checked against the text layer: identical). Pressure units not applicable. phi_V and phi_C derived by authors; d-d0 and sigma ratio raw. Sanity: m, d-d0 monotonic within blocks; phi_C and c_p vary smoothly.
needs_pass2_reason: text layer lacked most columns; table read from the image (pass-2 blind re-read advised)
